heading: Finance teams close the month faster with Kiteward
subheading: More than 2,000 companies use Kiteward to collect receipts, approve spending and reconcile company cards.

testimonials.quote: We used to spend the first week of every month chasing receipts. Now our close takes two days, and nobody on the team dreads it anymore.
Approvals happen on the go. Managers approve from their phones between meetings, so reimbursements go out the same week.
The card reconciliation alone saved us a part-time hire. Matching statements to receipts is finally automatic.
Setup took an afternoon. Our auditors now get a clean export instead of a shoebox of paper.
Spending limits per team mean I no longer approve every coffee. I only see the expenses that actually need me.
Support answered within minutes when we moved over our old categories. The migration was painless.
